attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using events in your projects to trigger things to happen without user input!

questions.hint: In a computer program, what happens when an event occurs?
questions.title: [Select one] In a computer program, what is an event?

answers.text: A party at a bowling alley
An action triggering code to run
The specific order of steps in code
Stored data that can be named, updated, and changed

questions.correctResponse: In a computer program, an event can happen either through a user action, like pressing a button, or when a specific overlap happens in a project, like when a sprite hits a wall.

questions.hint: What option(s) will trigger a chunk of code to run?
questions.title: [Select one] What are some examples of events in a computer program?
questions.correctResponse: An event block waits for a specific action, and when that action happens, the code within it runs.

questions.hint: Which code block should you use to run code when a sprite hits a wall?
questions.title: [Select one]  _______________ is a tilemap event block that runs code when a sprite hits a wall.
questions.correctResponse: Event code blocks say the action they are triggered by on the code block.

questions.hint: What else might trigger an event?
questions.title: [Select one] Event code blocks are triggered by _________.

answers.text: Actions done by the user, such as pressing the A or B button
Actions done within the game, such as on sprite created

questions.correctResponse: Events can be actions done both by the user or done within the game.

subgroups.title: Tilemap and Lifecycle Events!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using events in your projects to trigger things to happen without user input!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Orange Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about how to add events into your tilemap project. Events occur when a certain action triggers a set of code to run. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Party Planner
badges.description: Use events to control actions in a project with a tilemap.

badges.title: Trip Wire
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite overlaps a specific tilemap tile.

badges.title: Watch Out for That...!
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite hits a tilemap wall.

badges.title: New Tile Who Dis?
badges.description: Use an event to change a tile on a tilemap.

badges.title: Birthday Party
badges.description: Use an event to make something happen when a sprite is created.

badges.title: Farewell Party
badges.description: Use an event to make something happen when a sprite is destroyed.

badges.title: Ticking Clock
badges.description: Set a sprite’s lifespan in a project.
